slides.headline: Build your safety net before you invest
slides.subhead: An emergency fund keeps one surprise from becoming a crisis.

points.title: How much
points.text: Many people aim for three to six months of expenses.

points.title: Where to keep it
points.text: Somewhere safe and easy to reach, not locked away.

points.title: When to use it
points.text: Only for real emergencies, then top it up again.

slides.headline: Safety net first. Then SIP.
slides.cta: Save this for your money checklist
slides.footnote: General education, not advice for any individual.

caption: A safety net comes before investing. Set aside a few months of expenses somewhere easy to reach, and use it only when you truly need it. Then begin your SIP with a calmer mind. #EmergencyFund #MoneyChecklist #PersonalFinance #India #MutualFunds
